name: modal-meter
description: Watches your Modal apps from the CLI, in projects that use Modal: running apps and containers on the status line, a toast when one has been up too long, today's spend where the CLI reports it, and a pane to stop an app (after you confirm). One session polls for all the open ones; a CLI that refuses (no token, a config error) is left alone for an hour, with its own reason shown. No model calls.

modalCommand.title: Modal command
modalCommand.description: How to run the Modal CLI, split on spaces (for example `python3 -m modal` or `uv run modal`). Empty tries `modal`, then `python3 -m modal`.

pollSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often Modal is read. One session on this machine runs `modal app list --json` this often and the others share its answer; the interval doubles (up to 10 minutes) while the CLI is slow or times out.

alertMinutes.title: Alert after (minutes)
alertMinutes.description: Toast when an app has had containers running for longer than this, and again every this many minutes while it keeps running. Deployed apps with no containers never alert.

budgetToday.title: Daily budget (USD)
budgetToday.description: Toast once when today's Modal spend passes this many dollars. Needs a Modal CLI with `modal billing report`; 0 turns it off.

alwaysPoll.title: Watch every project
alwaysPoll.description: Read Modal in every project. Off, modal-meter watches only projects whose Python imports modal or whose dependency files name it, and any session once you run /modal or a modal command in it.

cliRetryMinutes.title: Retry a refusing CLI after (minutes)
cliRetryMinutes.description: When `modal app list` fails for a reason other than a timeout (no token, a config error, a usage error), no session runs the Modal CLI again for this long; the status line and the pane show the CLI's own reason and the wait. /modal retries at once.
